results.title: Reco raises $30 million Series B to secure AI SaaS adoption across enterprises | Ctech
results.content:
Cybersecurity company Reco has raised $30 million in a Series B round led by Oren Zeev’s Zeev Ventures, with participation from all of the company’s existing investors, including Insight Partners and Boldstart Ventures, as well as new corporate investors: Workday Ventures, TIAA Ventures, S Ventures, and Quadrille Capital. The round brings the company’s total capital raised to approximately $85 million and comes less than 10 months after Reco’s previous funding round. [...] Founded by Ofer Klein (CEO), Gal Nakash (CPO), and Dr. Tal Shapira (CRO), Reco employs around 100 people, split evenly between Israel and the United States.

The funding follows rapid growth, with the company reporting 500% growth between 2023 and 2024, and an additional 400% growth in 2025, driven by the sharp rise in AI adoption and the expansion of Shadow AI, the use of AI tools outside the approval and supervision of IT systems. [...] Reco aims to deliver a purpose-built AI SaaS security platform designed specifically for the AI era, securing AI adoption across Salesforce, ChatGPT, Copilot, and hundreds of thousands of AI SaaS apps and agents. These AI Agents continuously monitor SaaS environments to provide real-time visibility into applications, users, permissions, and AI-driven activity, including AI-powered apps, autonomous agents, embedded AI features, SaaS-to-SaaS AI interactions, and Model Context Protocols (MCP).
